heads.8.01:
Item 8.01. Other Events.
On October 21, 2026, the Board of Directors of
United Therapeutics Corporation (the Company) approved a share repurchase program (the Share Repurchase Program), authorizing
the purchase by the Company of up to $2.0 billion of the Company’s common stock. This authorization will remain in effect for a
one-year period ending October 21, 2027.
On October 22, 2026, the Company issued a press
release announcing the Share Repurchase Program. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form
8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.

Exhibit 99.1
For Immediate Release
United Therapeutics
Corporation Announces Additional $2 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization
SILVER SPRING,
M.D. and RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C., October 22, 2026: United Therapeutics Corporation (Nasdaq: UTHR), a public benefit corporation,
announced today that the company’s Board of Directors has authorized a new share repurchase program for up to $2 billion of the
company’s common stock, available through October 21, 2027.
“We have
the balance sheet and free cash flow to fund our long-term ambitions and the confidence to act decisively when our own shares represent
a compelling investment,” said James Edgemond, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of United Therapeutics. “This
authorization is a clear reflection of our deep conviction in the future of our company, our disciplined approach to capital allocation,
and our commitment to delivering durable long-term value for shareholders.”
